findings.issue: «la tarde» is the afternoon (midday until nightfall) in current Latin American Spanish; הָעָרֶב is the evening, so the time limit falls earlier than the token.
«el tocante» can be the qal active masculine singular «one who touches», but in current Spanish «tocante» usually means «concerning».

notes: Person, number, both wash clauses, plural waters, and both qal unclean verbs match the tokens.
